key_backtick: Press backtick with your left pinky.
key_1: Press one with your left pinky.
key_2: Press two with your left ring finger.
key_3: Press three with your left middle finger.
key_4: Press four with your left index finger.
key_5: Press five with your left index finger.
key_6: Press six with your right index finger.
key_7: Press seven with your right index finger.
key_8: Press eight with your right middle finger.
key_9: Press nine with your right ring finger.
key_0: Press zero with your right pinky.
key_minus: Press minus with your right pinky.
key_equal: Press equals with your right pinky.
key_q: Press Q with your left pinky.
key_w: Press W with your left ring finger.
key_e: Press E with your left middle finger.
key_r: Press R with your left index finger.
key_t: Press T with your left index finger.
key_y: Press Y with your right index finger.
key_u: Press U with your right index finger.
key_i: Press I with your right middle finger.
key_o: Press O with your right ring finger.
key_p: Press P with your right pinky.
key_lbracket: Press left bracket with your right pinky.
key_rbracket: Press right bracket with your right pinky.
key_backslash: Press backslash with your right pinky.
key_a: Press A with your left pinky.
key_s: Press S with your left ring finger.
key_d: Press D with your left middle finger.
key_f: Press F with your left index finger.
key_g: Press G with your left index finger.
key_h: Press H with your right index finger.
key_j: Press J with your right index finger.
key_k: Press K with your right middle finger.
key_l: Press L with your right ring finger.
key_semicolon: Press semicolon with your right pinky.
key_quote: Press the quote key with your right pinky.
key_z: Press Z with your left pinky.
key_x: Press X with your left ring finger.
key_c: Press C with your left middle finger.
key_v: Press V with your left index finger.
key_b: Press B with your left index finger.
key_n: Press N with your right index finger.
key_m: Press M with your right index finger.
key_comma: Press comma with your right middle finger.
key_period: Press period with your right ring finger.
key_slash: Press slash with your right pinky.
key_space: Press the space bar with your thumb.
shift_left: Hold the left shift key with your left pinky.
shift_right: Hold the right shift key with your right pinky.
welcome: Hi! Welcome to TouchTyping. Rest your left index finger on F and your right index finger on J. Feel the small bumps. Your other fingers line up on the home row, and your thumbs rest on the space bar.
start: Ready? Start typing whenever you are.
careful: Take it slow. Accuracy first, speed will follow.
look: Watch your fingers, and try not to look at the keyboard.
fail: Not quite yet. That's okay, try again slowly.
best: New personal best! You're getting faster.
badge: Congratulations, you earned a new achievement!
caps: Caps Lock is on. Please turn it off.
preview: Hi, I'm your typing tutor. Let's learn to type with all ten fingers.
onb_bumps: Feel the bumps on F and J. They help you find home without looking.
onb_colors: Green means correct, red means a mistake, and blue shows the next character.
onb_fix: Made a mistake? Press backspace to fix it. It still counts as a mistake, so go slow.
